label: EU-dsa-2022 Article 63

obligations.text: Where necessary to meet the objectives set out in Article 61(2), the Board shall in particular:

Digital Services Coordinators and, where applicable, other competent authorities that do not follow the opinions, requests or recommendations addressed to them adopted by the Board shall provide the reasons for this choice, including an explanation on the investigations, actions and the measures that they have implemented, when reporting pursuant to this Regulation or when adopting their relevant decisions, as appropriate.
